channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Delhi SIR: Public audit in two booths finds over 100 voters wrongly marked absent, shifted, or dead
item.description: Voters residing at the same address for multiple decades express anger that they were marked ‘untraceable’, ‘absent’, and permanently shifted, and their only option is to enrol afresh using Form 6

item.title: Delhi Police grants Congress NOC for November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan
item.description: On September 30, the INDIA bloc finalised a joint action plan over the SIR (Special Intensive Revision) row, including rallies and ‘save democracy marches’

item.title: 70 religious congregations in J&K, Ladakh delivered Friday sermons on common theme: Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema
item.description: “In a first-of-its-kind collective religious initiative, more than 70 major Friday congregations across Kashmir, Jammu and Ladakh responded to the call of the the MMU and delivered the sermon on the common theme of imaan (faith) on Friday, October 16,” says a spokesman of the MMU

item.title: Sahil Wakode death: Parents demand arrest of IIT Bombay professors as student groups protest at Azad Maidan
item.description: The protesters demanded action against Suryanarayana Doolla, Professor of Energy Science and Engineering, and Professor Shireesh B. Kedare, Director of IIT Bombay, along with a transparent investigation and stronger safeguards against caste discrimination

item.title: El Niño could intensify stress on Keralam’s forests and wildlife
item.description: According to the Forest Survey of India, Keralam reported 49 large forest fire incidents so far this year, compared with 52 in 2025. The amount and distribution of northeast monsoon rainfall will be crucial in determining water availability in forests and the extent of water stress on wildlife

item.title: Left student outfits to take out march to Lok Bhavan in Keralam on October 23
item.description: The march, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, will be inaugurated by Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan; leaders of the Communist Party of India and the Socialist Unity Centre of India (Communist) will also participate in the protest

item.title: BMC removes over 52,000 unauthorised banners, posters in Mumbai since January
item.description: During a special drive, between October 8 and 16, the BMC seized around 3,537 unauthorised advertisements, including banners, boards, posters and flags in Mumba

item.title: Durga Puja 2026: All set for the beat of the dhak
item.description: As India gears up for Durga Puja 2026, the air will once again thrum with the beat of the dhak. In this special package, we bring you stories from pandals across cities, meet the artisans shaping this year’s idols, and tune in to the music, food, and festive fervour that define the season.

item.title: YSRCP and TDP blame each other for Pulivendula violence
item.description: While Kadapa MP Avinash Reddy accuses the police of trying to create scare among YSRCP activists, TDP leader ‘B.Tech’ Ravi says the YSR family and its supporters are finding it hard to stomach the large number of aspirants filing nominations in its citadel

item.title: Local body elections: SEC directs maintenance of law and order as violence continues in some areas
item.description: Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha orders officials to bring the situation under control, deploy adequate security at all the nomination filing centres so that candidates can file their papers by 3 p.m. on October 18

item.title: Brahmin body demands representation for community in GVMC elections
IMD predicts wet spell in Andhra Pradesh till October 21
item.description: The weatherman issues orange alert for the districts of Chittoor, Tirupati and Nellore till 3 p.m. on October 18; yellow alert remains for Rayalaseema and central Andhra Pradesh

item.title: Dasara rush swells at Pandit Nehru Bus Station in Vijayawada
item.description: APSRTC is operating 5,261 special buses to cater to the festive surge in passenger traffic within the State and from major cities such as Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Chennai

item.title: Nearly one lakh devotees visit Kanaka Durga Temple on Day 7 of Dasara festivities
Left parties, Congress back candidature of Venkateswara Rao for VMC Mayor post
item.description: Congress withdraws from the mayoral contest following an appeal made by the former IPS officer; CPI and CPI(M) reach an understanding on the corporator seats to be contested

item.title: Peak load of power crosses 20K MW in Telangana, daily energy consumption yet to breach record
Officials close to BRS misleading Ministers, alleges Madhu Yaskhi Goud
Comprehensive Telangana land resurvey to be completed in three phases for clear ownership rights: Ponguleti
item.description: Survey completed in 285 villages; first phase targeted for completion by November-end

item.title: Kanthapuram faction to protest against lack of representation in Keralam Waqf Board
item.description: Kerala Muslim Jamaath claims that justice has been denied to their Sunni faction, which manages a significant portion of Waqf properties across Keralam

item.title: Nedumbassery crash: Keralam court denies bail to all four accused
item.description: Nedumbassery police had arrested Suhail Sajeev, 19, who allegedly drove the car under the influence of alcohol, and three co-passengers, Ninav, 19; Ameer, 20; and Joel, 20 in connection with the accident that claimed three lives; the accused are likely to move the district court in appeal

item.title: Keralam CM sets deadline for preparations at Sabarimala, seeks progress reports
item.description: Satheesan reviews preparations for pilgrimage season at Pampa, directs that all works at the Sannidhanam, Pampa, Nilackal and other pilgrimage centres be completed on a war footing

item.title: Fire breaks out at Cantonment House
Keralam govt. increases DA, DR from 35% to 37%
RGCB researchers receive ₹7 crore grant to develop rapid, biopsy-free cervical cancer detection technology
Keralam’s Waqf board chairperson terms Centre’s mandate on non-Muslim members ‘anti-Muslim’
item.description: Newly appointed chairperson M.C. Mayin Haji says his immediate priority is to resolve the 600-odd cases pending before the board. He says he intends to revive the board’s welfare activities that have declined due to reduced grants

item.title: New bridge ends seven years of isolation for tribal hamlets of Munderi in Malappuram
item.description: Residents of Vaniyampuzha, Iruttukuthi, Kumbalappara and Tharippapotti hamlets had relied on bamboo rafts to cross the Chaliyar after the old bridge collapsed

item.title: ‘Everything is in party’s cognisance,’ says JD(U) leader on MLA’s claim of ‘killing nine people’
item.description: Working president of the ruling NDA member expresses confidence ahead of Legislative Council election even as the disgruntled ‘bahubali’ MLA makes a U-turn on his controversial statement

item.title: Sugarcane farmers on protest path again to seek fair share in sugar and ethanol revenues
item.description: Sugarcane farmers are undertaking the ‘Hubballi Chalo’ padayatra, putting focus again on many long-unresolved issues

item.title: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar promises meeting of all stakeholders after Dasara
item.description: The Chief Minister narrated all the steps that the State government had taken to address the issues raised by the protesting farmers and also that of the Centre.

item.title: Law itself a living conversation: CJI Surya Kant
item.description: Earlier, the convocation was postponed after students and alumni of NLSIU, Bengaluru, came out in support of students at NALSAR, Hyderabad, opposing CJI Surya Kant at the convocation over his remarks on the youth of the country

item.title: ‘Cabinet decision on Bangalore Turf Club land for High Court this month’
Food safety officials inspect 100 sweet units on third day of drive, issue notices to 15
item.description: 383 samples collected in three days; ₹7,000 fine imposed on two operators and 30 kg of misbranded khova seized

item.title: Over 50 lakh devotees expected to attend Karthigai Deepam festival in Tiruvannamalai: Minister Aadhav Arjuna
item.description: Shuttle services between the bus termini and town should also be operated for devotees, as no vehicle will be allowed to enter town, especially during Maha Deepam, to avoid traffic congestion, he said

item.title: AIADMK will rise like a phoenix, says EPS at event held to mark party’s 55th founding day
item.description: The founding day was celebrated at the party’s headquarters in Royapettah

item.title: India, Bangladesh need to cooperate on ‘grey areas’ in Bay of Bengal maritime boundaries
item.description: A UN Tribunal on the India-Bangladesh maritime boundary dispute in 2014 awarded Bangladesh 19,467 sq. km of the 25,602 sq km sea area of Bay of Bengal

item.title: Easy financing and lifestyle upgrades fuel appliance demand this festive season
item.description: Consumers are willing to stretch their budgets with easy EMI options encouraging them to spend more, despite an increase in prices of many products, say retailers

item.title: Regime change in Delhi will happen by voting only, says Prakash Raj
item.description: Addressing a protest gathering seeking the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at Kozhikode beach, the actor says the regime will be changed through votes, not like Bangladesh, Nepal or Sri Lanka

item.title: Gothrajyothi meet brings together 300 Adivasi farmers in Wayanad
item.description: The initiative aims to integrate the traditional knowledge of Adivasi farmers with modern science to improve livelihood security

item.title: Foundation stone laid for animal shelter in Wayanad
item.description: The facility enables authorities to evacuate animals in advance when disaster warnings are issued and provide them with fodder, water, and basic veterinary care

item.title: INL criticises reconstitution of Keralam Waqf Board
item.description: INL leader criticises the board’s composition and accuses the UDF government of selecting members entirely on political considerations

item.title: Census 2027: The pressures of counting India
item.description: Enumerators working on the Census are facing several challenges in the field, including heat, connectivity issues, and safety concerns. Though the exercise is being conducted through a digital system designed for real-time monitoring, field workers say conditions on the ground and supervisory instructions are affecting data collection. Vijaita Singh reports on the challenges

item.title: Congress alleges ‘RSS employment scheme’ as Centre opens Census enumerator posts to private individuals
item.description: Party questions Centre’s decision to widen pool of enumerators; former Census official cites shortage of government teachers

item.title: ABVP organises student rally in Lucknow, urge students to raise voice for protection of democracy
item.description: ABVP members participated in the rally from Lucknow University to Gandhi Chowk in Hazratganj, against what they call as attempts to weaken democracy and democratic institutions

item.title: 36 new wildlife records put Keralam’s Peechi’s biodiversity in the spotlight
item.description: Survey across three sanctuaries documents 395 bird, butterfly and odonates species, including 24 endemics of the Western Ghats

item.title: Keralam Forest department removes fences, iron bars blocking movement of wild elephants in Chinnakkanal
item.description: The decision came out of talks held between forest officials, tribal residents, and people’s representatives at the Panthadikkalam tribal settlement under the Devikulam forest range, following the death of a tribal farmer

item.title: Govt. schemes should be delivered more effectively to farmers: Srinivas Poojary
item.description: Many people have improved their lives by growing multiple crops along with horticultural crops, says the MP.

item.title: Non-monsoon timetable will be effective on Konkan Railway network from October 21
item.description: During the monsoon timetable, which came into effect on June 15, trains on the Konkan Railway route operated at reduced speeds as a precaution against rain-related mishaps

item.title: Highways Secretary inspects road widening, ROB works in Vellore
item.description: Highways officials said that the team assessed quality of raw materials used for the work

item.title: Businessman attacked near Baramati airport; shifted to Pune for treatment
item.description: According to the hospital, Mr. Suryavanshi is under observation, and a medical team is closely monitoring his condition. A detailed evaluation will be conducted to determine the appropriate course of treatment, says hospital

item.title: Chennai Mayor accuses govt. of delaying monsoon preparedness works
item.description: She says that government should have held meetings in July or August; she also flags inadequate allocation of funds for civic infra maintenance

item.title: Centre committed to meeting demands of the region, says Ladakh Chief Secretary
item.description: The Union Home Ministry’s proposal, which was rejected by civil society bodies, involved constitutional amendments and subsequent regulations for a directly elected U.T.-level body, says an official; meaningful negotiations require mutual trust, says Chief Secretary

item.title: War of words in Haryana: CM Saini pitches prosperity, Congress alleges rising crime, debt
item.description: The Chief Minister said that while Congress leaders frequently claimed to have made Haryana a leading State during their tenure, the reality was that the State had emerged as number one in corruption, nepotism, fear, favouritism and regional discrimination under Congress rule

item.title: Uttarakhand Minister Rekha Arya’s husband accuses her of amassing ₹210 crore in illegal assets
item.description: Girdhari Lal Sahu calls the audio recording released by the Minister ‘fabricated’; Congress calls for impartial probe

item.title: India's Para Asian Games contingent showcases 5,000 years of heritage
item.description: More than 100 Indian athletes took part in the ceremony, led by Paralympic medallist sprinter Simran Sharma and top shuttler Pramod Bhagat, who carried the national flag as the contingent marched in with the Tricolour fluttering proudly

item.title: KWA administrative fee on tanker operators hits water supply in Kochi
item.description: Administrative fee is being levied in addition to water charges, increasing the financial burden on suppliers

item.title: It was a wet blanket on fan enthusiasm at Chinnaswamy
Protests, match and festivals bring Bengaluru traffic to a standstill
SC bars online platforms from hosting subscription-based sexual content
item.description: The Court says that children do not cease to use the internet merely because the law prohibits them from doing so; they only move to other platforms that unregulated and even less safe

item.title: Law student pens down concise history of AIADMK
item.description: The writer says he relied on the news reports published in The Hindu for verifying information that he came across

item.title: Tiger Shroff firing incident: Opposition targets Fadnavis over 'deteriorating' law and order
item.description: Maharashtra Congress president Harshwardhan Sapkal accused the Mahayuti government of creating a "jungle raj" in the state following the firing incident involving Shroff and demanded CM Fadnavis's resignation on moral grounds over deteriorating law and order
